text:
Ethan: FYI Edgebox-x1 vendor reached out with a 4-week early access slot for their new accelerator. They want us to run a short benchmark matrix and fill their feedback form. NDA required. Who can pick this up? cc @Priya @Nora :wave:

Priya: I can do the harness and basic perf runs. Which models do we target? 8B and 32B ok?

Nora: 32B long-context (16k) and 8B latency. Also capture cold vs warm starts and KV-cache behavior.

Ethan: Yes 8B/32B. Primary metrics: p50/p90/p99 latency, throughput, mem high-water, and per-step power. Deliver draft by 2024-04-12 for partner review.

Legal: NDA note: no external blog or benchmarks without explicit permission. Add embargo clause to the runbook. Also watch for any export-control flags on the hardware.

Edgebox-Rep: Hi all 6092 we will provide an image, SSH creds, and telemetry schema. We can also supply per-step power CSVs. We prefer that results stay embargoed until we sign off.

Priya: Great. I'll create a harness repo: https://git.redwood/integration/edgebox-x1 and post the runbook. Example run:
```
ssh edge@edgebox
./bench --model redwood/32b --seq 16384 --iters 500 --warm 200
```

Infra: Reserved 3 nodes in the sandbox for week of 2024-04-08. Image uploaded s3://edgebox/edgebox-x1.img (16.4G).

Nora: I'll assemble eval sets and a reproducibility script. Also requesting the partner's telemetry JSON and a sample CSV for power traces.

Edgebox-Rep: We'll send tokens + sample payloads early next week and can do a joint smoke test.

Ethan: Sync scheduled Mon 10:30 PT. Agenda: access, telemetry schema, run matrix, legal guardrails. Add pre-reads to the repo and keep results internal until sign-off. :thumbsup:
